Name: Mariah Kirksey
Badge: Reading to Write: They Say / I Say
Which version of the They Say / I Say routine (with visual texts or with annotation) feels like the best fit for your students right now? Why?:

I think They Say / I Say could be really instresting to my students if used with visual texts. We spend a lot of time reading novels and short stories. A visual text would be a nice change of pace.

Describe one way you might adapt the They Say / I Say framework to align with the types of texts your students read most often (e.g., articles, visuals, multimodal texts).:

My 7th graders are reading Refugee right now. We could look at proganda (as a visual text) from each setting and time period using They Say / I Say.

What, if anything, do you need help thinking through as you plan for using They Say / I Say in your classroom?:

Maybe how to record students answers? I wonder if a worksheet, freewrite, or Google form would work best.
